subscription.note: Official Q1 FAQ states the Q1 Card and digital billing are free; postal invoice is optional and excluded from charging cost.

directOffers.note: Gross Q1 Autostrom price valid at Q1 charging stations until revoked. Third-party acceptance stations have different prices and must not inherit this tariff.
